entries.name: No high-confidence setup
entries.meaning: Atlas sees no candidate with enough confidence and alignment to justify a trade.
entries.teaching_label_hint: correct_hold unless a clean setup was present before the move and Atlas missed it.
entries.operator_focus: Review whether structure, momentum, location, macro, and execution quality were aligned at decision time.

entries.name: structure_too_weak
entries.meaning: Market structure is unclear, mixed, ranging, or not strong enough to justify directional execution.
entries.teaching_label_hint: correct_hold unless a clean structure break or pullback confirmation was visible.
entries.operator_focus: Check whether HH/HL or LH/LL was truly present before calling it missed_trade.

entries.name: no_clear_setup
entries.meaning: Atlas cannot map current price action to a complete actionable playbook.
entries.teaching_label_hint: correct_hold if ingredients are missing; bad_setup if Atlas nearly acted anyway.
entries.operator_focus: Identify which ingredient is missing: structure, location, momentum, confirmation, or execution.

entries.name: spread_liquidity_too_poor
entries.meaning: Execution friction can erase the setup edge through spread, liquidity, or slippage.
entries.teaching_label_hint: execution_issue when the idea is recognizable but trading cost is unsafe.
entries.operator_focus: Do not solve this by weakening setup logic. Track it separately as broker/session quality.

entries.name: macro_context_conflict_too_strong
entries.meaning: DXY/US10Y or broader macro context conflicts with the chart idea enough to reduce confidence.
entries.teaching_label_hint: correct_hold when chart and macro are fighting; too_cautious only if macro conflict was stale or irrelevant.
entries.operator_focus: Teach whether macro conflict was actually meaningful for that moment.

entries.name: event_risk_too_high
entries.meaning: High-impact news or unstable event conditions make fills and follow-through unreliable.
entries.teaching_label_hint: correct_hold unless the event risk classification was wrong.
entries.operator_focus: Distinguish good setup from unsafe timing.

entries.name: mid_range_entry
entries.meaning: Price is away from an edge/reaction zone, reducing reward asymmetry and clarity.
entries.operator_focus: Only label missed_trade if a real edge or retest was present, not just movement after the fact.
